scripts.generate:prototype-api:schema: uv run --directory ../.. --package notarius-api python -m notarius_api.prototype_openapi apps/web/openapi/prototype.json
scripts.generate:prototype-api: npm run generate:prototype-api:schema && openapi-typescript openapi/prototype.json --immutable --alphabetize --empty-objects-unknown -o src/lib/api/generated/prototype.ts
scripts.check:prototype-api: npm run generate:prototype-api:schema && openapi-typescript openapi/prototype.json --immutable --alphabetize --empty-objects-unknown -o src/lib/api/generated/prototype.ts --check
